pre_caption: The scene opens with a wide shot from the subjects' eye level, showing a woman in the left-center and a young girl to her right, both seated on a couch in the middle ground. In the background, cardboard boxes are stacked on the left and in the center, while a curtain hangs on the right. A small amplifier occupies the middle ground on the far right. The camera then moves forward, tightening the frame into a medium close-up on the woman, who remains in the left-center while the girl on the right shifts into the out-of-focus background.
